tool_analysis:
Step Analysis:
- The recorded session logs a full edit flow for Magento 1.x product id=2796: navigate to product edit URL, authenticate if needed, update General fields (name, sku, weight), open Prices tab and update price, set Status and Visibility, open Inventory and set Qty/Stock Availability, open Websites and Categories tabs to assign websites and categories, then Save and Save and Continue. Stable selectors were extracted using name/id attributes (e.g., input[name='name'], input[name='sku'], input#weight, input[name='product[price]'], select[name='status'], select[name='visibility'], input[name='product[stock_data][qty]'], select[name='product[stock_data][is_in_stock]'], input[name='product[website_ids][]'], and category checkbox inputs by value).

Task Definition:
- Create a deterministic, parameterized tool that edits a Magento product identified by {product_id}: set name, sku, weight, price, status, visibility, qty and stock availability; optionally assign website(s) and category(ies); then save changes (Save and Continue Edit). The tool assumes an already-authenticated admin session.

Action Plan (ordered):
1. Navigate directly to the product edit URL using {product_id} (fast and deterministic).
2. Confirm page loaded (extract page content). Fail early if product id not present (consumer should check output). 
3. Fill General fields: name (input[name='name']), sku (input[name='sku']), weight (input#weight or input[name='weight']).
4. Switch to Prices tab (click tab anchor) and set price (input[name='product[price]']).
5. Set status (select[name='status']) and visibility (select[name='visibility']).
6. Switch to Inventory tab and set qty (input[name='product[stock_data][qty]']) and stock availability (select[name='product[stock_data][is_in_stock]']).
7. Assign website(s): for each id in {website_ids} (comma-separated) click checkbox input[name='product[website_ids][]'][value='{id}'] if present. (Handled by an agent step to iterate reliably.)
8. Assign categories: for each id in {category_ids} (comma-separated) click checkbox input[type='checkbox'][value='{id}'] within the categories tree. (Handled by an agent step.)
9. Click Save and Continue Edit (button[title='Save and Continue Edit'] or button#save_and_continue) to persist and remain on the edit page.
10. Extract page content to confirm 'The product has been saved.' or similar success message.

Variable Identification (parameters required):
- product_id (used in URL)
- name, sku, weight, price (used for corresponding inputs)
- status, visibility (selects by visible text)
- qty, stock_availability (inventory fields)
- category_ids (optional, comma-separated category id values to check)
- website_ids (optional, comma-separated website id values to check)

Step Optimization and Notes:
- Use direct URL navigation to /admin/catalog_product/edit/id/{product_id}/ rather than navigating through product grid.
- Use name-attribute selectors (input[name='...']) and id-based selectors (input#weight, button#save) as primary selectors — these are stable across Magento installations and unaffected by localization.
- Use tab anchors (href fragments or tab ids) to switch tabs before editing fields rendered inside other tabs (e.g., Prices, Inventory) to avoid trying to write into hidden elements.
- For website/category lists (variable-length), an 'agent' step is used to iterate over comma-separated ids and click the matching checkboxes; this avoids creating a fixed number of click steps and keeps the main sequence deterministic.
- The tool always clicks 'Save and Continue Edit' to persist changes without leaving the edit page (matches the recorded session). This keeps the tool single-purpose and deterministic.
- Authentication is NOT part of this tool (sessions must already be authenticated). If a login page is encountered the automation should fail early.

Risk & Stability:
- Button titles and some tab labels can be localized — the selectors chosen prefer stable name/id or onclick patterns where possible. If localization is expected, prefer id/onclick based selectors or pass exact visible text matching the target locale.
- Category and website checkbox selectors are inferred from typical Magento 1 markup (product[website_ids][] and input[value='<category_id>']). They should be validated against the target DOM before running at scale.

Essential-only steps: All steps included are essential to perform the product-edit-and-save task. No exploratory, sorting, or optional UI tasks are present.
name: magento_edit_product_tool
description: Edit a Magento 1.x product by product_id: update main fields (name, sku, weight, price), status, visibility, inventory (qty & stock), assign websites and categories, then save (Save and Continue Edit). Uses stable name/id-based selectors and tab anchors for reliability. Assumes an already-authenticated admin session.

steps.description: Open the Magento product edit page for the provided product_id.
Verify the edit page loaded and contains expected product id/heading before making edits.
steps.goal: Confirm product edit page loaded and contains product id {product_id}

steps.description: Set Product Name using input[name='name'] (General tab).
Set Weight using input#weight or input[name='weight'] (General tab).
Open the Prices tab so the Price field becomes visible.
Wait briefly for the Prices tab content to render.
Set Base Price on the Prices tab (input[name='product[price]']).
Open the Inventory tab to edit inventory fields.
Wait briefly for the Inventory tab to become active and its inputs to be available.
Set inventory Qty in the Inventory tab (input[name='product[stock_data][qty]']).
Set Stock Availability (In Stock / Out of Stock).
Assign product to website ids listed in {website_ids} by toggling the corresponding checkboxes (agentic iteration).
steps.task: For each website id in the comma-separated string '{website_ids}', locate the checkbox input[name='product[website_ids][]'][value='<id>'] (scoped to the product edit form) and click it if it is not already checked. If {website_ids} is empty or not provided, do nothing.

steps.description: Assign product to categories by checking category checkboxes using their value attributes (agentic iteration).
steps.task: For each category id in the comma-separated string '{category_ids}', locate the checkbox input[type='checkbox'][value='<id>'] inside the categories tree container and click it if it is not already checked. If {category_ids} is empty or not provided, do nothing.

steps.description: Click Save and Continue Edit to persist changes while remaining on the edit page.
steps.cssSelector: button[title='Save and Continue Edit'], button#save_and_continue, button[id*='save'][id*='continue']

steps.description: Capture page messages to verify successful save (e.g., 'The product has been saved.').
steps.goal: Confirm the product save was successful by extracting success messages

input_schema.name: product_id
input_schema.description: Product numeric id used in the admin edit URL (e.g. '2796'). This is used to navigate to the product edit page: /admin/catalog_product/edit/id/{product_id}/

input_schema.name: name
input_schema.description: Product Name to set (field input[name='name']). Required on the product form.

input_schema.name: sku
input_schema.description: Product SKU to set (field input[name='sku']). Required on the product form.

input_schema.name: weight
input_schema.description: Weight value to set (e.g. '1.7500'). Targets input#weight or input[name='weight'].

input_schema.name: price
input_schema.description: Base price to set (e.g. '29.99'). Targets input[name='product[price]'] on the Prices tab.

input_schema.name: status
input_schema.description: Product status visible text to select in select[name='status']. Use 'Enabled' or 'Disabled'.

input_schema.name: visibility
input_schema.description: Visibility option visible text to select in select[name='visibility'].

input_schema.name: qty
input_schema.description: Inventory quantity to set (numeric string). Targets input[name='product[stock_data][qty]'] in the Inventory tab. Marked required because the page shows Qty*.

input_schema.name: stock_availability
input_schema.description: Stock availability visible text to select in select[name='product[stock_data][is_in_stock]'. Use 'In Stock' or 'Out of Stock'.

input_schema.name: category_ids
input_schema.description: Comma-separated list of category ids to (check) assign the product to (e.g. '8,70'). Each id will be clicked using input[type='checkbox'][value='<ID>'] inside the categories tree. Optional.

input_schema.name: website_ids
input_schema.description: Comma-separated list of website ids to (check) assign the product to (e.g. '1'). Each id will be clicked using input[name='product[website_ids][]'][value='<ID>']. Optional.
